fragments.text: אַב הָרַחֲמִים
הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּוֹן תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם:
כִּי בְךָ לְבַד בָּטָֽחְנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא אֲדוֹן עוֹלָמִים:
O Father of mercy,
benefit Zion through Thy favour, build up the walls of Jerusalem.
For in Thee alone do we trust, O King, lofty and exalted God, master of eternity.

title.en: Prayer while the Scrolls of the Torah are taken out of the Ark

fragments.text: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַֽיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה קֽוּמָה יְיָ וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ:
כִּי מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא תוֹרָה וּדְבַר יְיָ מִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם:
בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ:
It was when the Holy Ark set out that Moses said: Arise, O Lord, that Thine enemies may be scattered and that those who hate Thee, may flee from Thy countenance.
From Zion does Torah go forth and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
Blessed be He, who in His holiness gave the Torah to His people Israel.

head.en: Prayer while the Scrolls of the Torah are taken out of the Ark

instructions.text: The Holy Ark is opened and, while the reader takes out two Torah scrolls, the congregation says:

fragments.text: יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת:
נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה
וְנַקֵּה:
The Lord, the Lord is a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and great in kindness and truth;
He preserves kindness to the thousandth generation, forgives guilt, transgression and sin,
and purifies.

instructions.text: תפלה משערי ציון לאמר בשעת הוצאת ס״ת.

fragments.text: גַּדְּלוּ לַייָ אִתִּי. וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו:
Magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt His Name together.

instructions.text: The reader, holding the scroll of the Torah in front of him, says:

fragments.text: עַל הַכֹּל יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא: שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל־מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: בָּעוֹלָמוֹת שֶׁבָּרָא הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהָעוֹלָם הַבָּא: כִּרְצוֹנוֹ וְכִרְצוֹן יְרֵאָיו וְכִרְצוֹן כָּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל: צוּר

הָעוֹלָמִים אֲדוֹן כָּל־הַבְּרִיּוֹת אֱלוֹהַּ כָּל־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת: הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּמֶרְחֲבֵי מָרוֹם הַשּׁוֹכֵן בִּשְׁמֵי שְׁמֵי קֶדֶם: קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ עַל הַחַיּוֹת וּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ עַל כִּסֵּא הַכָּבוֹד: וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ שִׁמְךָ בָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָּל־חָי: וְנֹאמַר לְפָנָיו שִׁיר חָדָשׁ כַּכָּתוּב:
שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ שְׁמוֹ סֹלּוּ לָרוֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו:
וְנִרְאֵהוּ עַיִן בְּעַיִן בְּשׁוּבוֹ אֶל נָוֵהוּ כַּכָּתוּב:
כִּי עַיִן בְּעַיִן יִרְאוּ בְּשׁוּב יְיָ צִיּוֹן:
וְנֶאֱמַר
וְנִגְלָה כְּבוֹד יְיָ וְרָאוּ כָל־בָּשָׂר יַחְדָּו כִּי פִּי יְיָ דִּבֵּר:

Above all things let there be magnified, sanctified, praised, glorified, exalted and elevated the Name of the King of all kings, the Holy One, blessed be He, in the worlds that He created in this and the future world, according to His will and the will of those who fear Him and the will of the whole house of Israel. Rock of eternity, Lord of all creatures, God

of all souls, who dwells in the infinite heights, and resides in the primaeval heavens, His holiness is above the Hayoth, His holiness is above the glorious throne. And thus may Thy Name be sanctified among us, O Lord our God, before the eyes of all the living; and let us sing before Him a new song, as it is written: ‘
Sing to God, sing praise of His Name. Exalt Him who rides upon the clouds, Yah is His Name, and rejoice before Him.
We shall see Him eye to eye when He returns to His dwelling as it is written:
eye to eye shall they behold when the Lord returns to Zion.
And it was said: ‘
And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed and all flesh together shall see, for the mouth of the Lord has spoken

instructions.text: While the reader carries a Torah scroll to the reading desk, the congregation says:

fragments.text: אַב הָרַחֲמִים הוּא יְרַחֵם עַם עֲמוּסִים וְיִזְכּוֹר בְּרִית אֵתָנִים וְיַצִּיל נַפְשׁוֹתֵינוּ מִן הַשָּׁעוֹת הָרָעוֹת וְיִגְעַר בְּיֵצֶר הָרַע מִן הַנְּשׂוּאִים וְיָחֹן אוֹתָנוּ לִפְלֵיטַת עוֹלָמִים וִימַלֵּא מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֵינוּ בְּמִדָּה טוֹבָה יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים:

The father of mercy will have mercy upon the people borne by Him and remember the covenant with the eternal ones (forefathers) and deliver our souls from evil hours and rebuke the evil inclination from those whom He has lifted up and favour us for eternal refuge and fulfil our prayers with a full measure of salvation and compassion.
וְיַעֲזוֹר וְיָגֵן וְיוֹשִׁיעַ לְכָל הַחוֹסִים בּוֹ וְנֹאמַר אָמֵן: הַכֹּל הָבוּ גֹדֶל לֵאלֹהֵינוּ וּתְנוּ כָבוֹד לַתּוֹרָה כֹּהֵן קְרָב. יַעֲמוֹד
: בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ:
תּוֹרַת יְיָ תְּמִימָה מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ עֵדוּת יְיָ נֶאֱמָנָה מַחְכִּימַת פֶּתִי:
פִּקּוּדֵי יְיָ יְשָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי לֵב מִצְוַת יְיָ בָּרָה מְאִירַת עֵינָיִם:
יְיָ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן יְיָ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם:
הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת יְיָ צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ:

And He will help, protect and save all who shelter with Him, and let us say: Amen. Let all of you ascribe greatness to our God and honour the Torah, let the Cohen approach. Let there arise . . . Blessed be He, who in His holiness has given the Torah to His people Israel.
The Torah of the Lord is flawless, refreshing the soul; the testimony of the Lord is faithful, making the simple wise.
The precepts of the Lord are upright, causing the heart to rejoice, the commandment of the Lord is clear, giving light to the eyes.
The Lord gives strength to His people, the Lord blesses His people with peace:
God’s way is perfect, the Lord’s word is pure, a shield is He for all who shelter with Him.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בָּנוּ מִכָּל־הָעַמִּים, וְנָתַן־לָנוּ אֶת־תּוֹרָתוֹ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, נוֹתֵן הַתּוֹרָה:
Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who has chosen us from all peoples and given us His Torah. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, giver of the Torah.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לָנוּ תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת, וְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם נָטַע בְּתוֹכֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, נוֹתֵן הַתּוֹרָה:
Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who has given us the Torah of truth and implanted in us eternal life. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, giver of the Torah.
